g.text: LW01 — five numbers that summarise the reading experience

text.style: font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #64717d

g.text: Neutral is a defined behavioural profile; the balanced mean weights all 27 configured profiles equally.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #64717d

g.text: Ranges are descriptive minima and maxima over the complete factorial design, not confidence intervals.
